reasons: Four named APAP interventions do not meet the necessary 90-distinct-compound floor, even before compatible protocol and fixed scaffold/class support.
Replicates, dose/time groups, censored-event-style tables, liver enzymes and cytokines are not additional unique compounds or interchangeable binary rescue labels.
Missing cells are not zero; source 0/1 cells in time-to-event-style tables need event/censor definitions and cannot be interpreted as QSAR class labels.
CIL56/ConA experiments and genetic perturbations cannot be relabeled as molecular acetaminophen rescue.
Workbook headers do not resolve all APAP doses, strain/sex, timing, controls and event conventions; full protocol still needs review.

literature.interpretation: NAE 12:0 seedling-development screen, ten selected hits; the reviewed primary-root follow-up concerns MDPD and three structural analogues, not 10,000 measured primary-root outcomes. No complete compound-outcome table established.
literature.condition_discrepancies_preserved: Main text describes scoring after five days; methods describe six days. Figure 6 caption mentions both ten-day growth and representative seven-day images. No values silently harmonized.

literature.interpretation: Selected chemical effects under mechanical stress; indexed primary text does not establish a complete 456-compound numerical outcome table. Full supplementary rights and data remain unverified; publisher redirect failed.
Europe PMC metadata has no accessible OA full text; do not infer complete root outcomes or rights from the library size.

Subset selected from a prior liver-development screen; matched APAP injury outcomes and source reuse terms still needed. Europe PMC metadata OA=N is an access-route observation, not a blanket rights determination.

admission_requirements.requires: Complete endpoint-matched real outcomes, structures, protocol and reuse provenance; fixed disjoint scaffold/class support, then passing held-out evidence.
